visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor space with white walls and a light grey floor. A young girl with her hair in a ponytail and a young boy stand before a wall decorated with multiple, oversized, colorful 3D models resembling stylized feces in pastel shades of yellow, green, and blue. The girl wears a white t-shirt with black vertical stripes on the sleeves and light blue shorts, carrying a small pink Burberry handbag. She holds a purple poop-shaped model on a stick like a lollipop. The boy, in a purple t-shirt and grey shorts, holds a similar pink model. A smartphone is briefly visible at the bottom right. (2) The camera transitions to a medium close-up of the young boy's face. He maintains a neutral, slightly pensive expression while looking towards the person behind the camera. A pink poop model is partially visible in the background behind him. The lighting remains bright and even across his features. (3) The boy suddenly raises his hand, pointing his pink model towards the girl. His expression becomes animated as he speaks. A woman wearing a white t-shirt with 'Mardi' text and dark pants enters the frame from the right, bending over and laughing intensely. The camera shakes slightly, following her movement as she laughs. The colorful wall decorations remain visible in the shallow background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 來～各位！ [Subtitle]: 我們現在問一個..腦筋急轉彎喔！有一天有一個媽媽，她生了兩個小孩，一個叫做「洗衣」，一個叫做「洗襪」，他們都是過著，吃大便生活的！然後有一天呢..媽媽就煮好了，一桌大便，卻發現她煮的大便，被吃掉了？！她就問，你們兩個..小孩子！是誰吃了大便？洗衣就說：不是我！那我現在考考..弟弟.. (2) [Subtitle]: 那是誰吃了大便？ [Slogan]: (如果萌弟說洗襪就上當了) [Subtitle]: 洗襪＝是我 (台語). (3) [Subtitle]: 是妳吃的！ (4) [Variety]: 哈哈 [Slogan]: (比你爸有種)
